no_results: No findings for this filter. Review check status and limitations.
limits_note: Automated partial checks: not a complete security, SEO or accessibility assessment. Unexecuted checks are not passes.
no_selection: Choose a target and at least one available check.
source_url: GitHub base URL for language packs (optional)
update_url: GitHub JSON URL for version checks (optional)
no_source: No GitHub source configured yet. DE/EN and local language imports remain available.
confirm_close: A scan is running. Cancel and close?
msg_limit: Scan limit reached; results are incomplete.
fix_limit: Increase the limit if appropriate and scan again.
fix_too_large: Inspect separately or adjust the size limit.
fix_image_invalid: Check image format and file integrity.
fix_syntax: Inspect the reported location with the relevant tool.
msg_php_eval: Possible direct input flow into eval().
fix_php_eval: Review data flow manually; do not execute user input as code.
fix_tool_missing: Install the indicated package if needed and scan again.
msg_encoding_invalid: Text does not match its declared encoding.
fix_encoding_invalid: Align file encoding and charset declarations.
msg_html_parse: HTML parser reports a structural issue.
fix_html_parse: Inspect parser code and location using HTML5 rules.
msg_duplicate_id: HTML ID is used more than once.
fix_duplicate_id: Use unique IDs within the page.
fix_large_resource: Review necessity, image dimensions and compression.
fix_slow_response: Repeat measurements and consider network/server conditions.
fix_compression: Consider compression for suitable text resources.
fix_cache_header: Define suitable caching for static resources.
msg_description_missing: Meta description is missing or empty.
msg_title_missing: Page title is missing or empty.
fix_h1_missing: Review the main heading and document structure.
fix_heading_jump: Arrange headings in a logical hierarchy.
fix_lang_missing: Add an appropriate lang attribute to the html element.
fix_alt_missing: Provide meaningful alt text or empty alt for decoration.
msg_label_missing: Form field has no detectable label.
fix_label_missing: Add an associated label or accessible name.
msg_name_missing: Link or button has no detectable name.
fix_name_missing: Provide a clear visible or accessible name.
fix_plain_http: Use HTTPS for public sites; assess local test servers separately.
fix_csp_missing: Consider an appropriate CSP; absence alone does not prove a vulnerability.
fix_nosniff_missing: Review the header and correct MIME types.
msg_password_get: Password form does not use POST.
fix_password_get: Use POST over HTTPS; do not transmit passwords in URLs.
msg_mixed_content: HTTPS page references an HTTP resource.
msg_outside_root: Reference lies outside the scan root.
fix_outside_root: Review the project root and intended path.
msg_route_unknown: Local target missing; dynamic routing is possible.
fix_route_unknown: Check the route against the running web server.
fix_file_missing: Check spelling, case and relative path.
fix_fragment_missing: Match the target ID and fragment name.
fix_http_status: Review the status and access conditions; the status alone does not prove a broken link.
msg_robots_denied: Not checked: automated access disallowed by robots.txt.
fix_robots_denied: This is not an error of the website being scanned. Check the target manually if needed.
msg_redirect: Normal redirect detected; not an error in itself.
fix_redirect: Expand and review redirect targets if needed.
msg_redirect_boundary: Redirect to a different origin – final target not checked.
fix_redirect_boundary: The redirect alone is not a broken link. Check the final target manually or as a separate scan.
msg_rate_limit: HTTP 429: rate limit – scan result inconclusive.
fix_rate_limit: Respect Retry-After and retry later; further targets on this server were not requested.
fix_network_error: Cannot determine automatically. This does not confirm a broken link; review the target in a browser.
coverage: {done} individual checks executed · {skipped} not executed / not applicable
missing_tools: Missing tools: {packages}. See Tools for details.
local_path_required: Please select a local file or folder.
invalid_url: Please enter a valid HTTP/HTTPS address, e.g. example.org.
report_extension: Please use the .html or .json file extension.
tidy_note: tidy is an optional extra tool. The current HTML checker uses html5lib and does not run tidy.
section_errors: Errors in the checked website / scan
no_section_findings: No further findings in this group.
limit_max_resources: Resource limit reached: {value}. Further resources could not be checked. Increase the resource limit and run the scan again.
limit_max_pages: Page limit reached: {value}. Further pages could not be checked. Increase the page limit and run the scan again.
limit_max_depth: Maximum link depth reached: {value}. Pages linked at greater depth were not analyzed.
fix_http_missing: Check the target and source manually; correct or remove the link if needed.
fix_http_auth: Do not automatically treat this as a broken link. Check manually with appropriate access.
msg_http_forbidden: Automated request refused (HTTP 403) – do not automatically treat the link as broken; check manually.
fix_http_forbidden: Check in a normal browser; access restrictions may block automated requests.
msg_http_server: Server problem at the time of the scan (HTTP 5xx).
fix_http_server: Do not assume a permanently broken link. Retry later or check manually.
fix_http_timeout: Inconclusive; not a confirmed broken link. Check in a browser or repeat with a longer timeout.
msg_redirect_pending: Redirect response – target not conclusively checked.
fix_redirect_pending: Check the redirect manually; it is not automatically a broken link.
msg_robots_unavailable: Not checked: robots.txt could not be evaluated reliably.
fix_robots_unavailable: Retry later or check manually; this proves neither an access prohibition nor a broken link.
update_interval_help: Example: Every 1 weeks = once a week. One month equals 30 days. This only checks for new application versions and does not start a website scan.
count_unchecked: Of these, not fully checked / inconclusive
count_http_requests: Total HTTP requests (including robots.txt and redirects)
resource_budget: Limit: local files or HTTP requests
count_definition: Targets are unique file paths or normalized URLs without fragments. Checked means planned content/link checks completed or HTTP 404/410 was conclusively observed. Partial checks, missing tools and inconclusive responses remain pending. Known = checked + pending. HTTP requests and started content analyses are separate quantities, not success counts. Undiscovered pages are unknown; this is not the total size of the website.
finding_counts: Finding count per result group (individual occurrences, not resource counts)
legacy_counts: This older report does not contain auditable resource counts.
external_note: The target belongs to another domain. Its state does not establish a technical fault of the scanned website.
reason_pending_resources: At least one target is not fully or conclusively checked. This does not mean the website is faulty or the target is unreachable. Manually review inconclusive results and pending targets.
reason_missing_checks: At least one planned tool check was unavailable or failed. Review tool status and repeat affected checks.
finding_summary: Findings: {errors} website errors · {external_errors} external errors · {manual} manual review · {indeterminate} inconclusive · {warnings} warnings · {hints} hints · {unchecked} unchecked · {redirects} redirects
zero_limits: 0 = unlimited, including link depth and timeout. Positive values limit the scan.
log_help: Current application log. Changes are applied only with “Save log”.
log_changed: The log has changed since loading. Your edits remain in the editor. Copy them if needed and reload; new entries have not been overwritten.
resource_method: Static resources and link targets with source locations. HTTP 2xx confirms retrieval, not content validity. Literal fetch URLs without options and XHR with literal GET/HEAD targets are detected. Relative fetch URLs use the document base. Dynamic URLs and generated content need browser review. JavaScript is never executed; browser-internal console messages and other tabs are not evaluated.
wrong_program: This file is not for checkweb or has no program identifier. Expected program_id: checkweb. Nothing was applied.
languages_none: All available languages are already installed.
languages_load_failed: Could not load the language list: {reason}
log_ended: Application stopped | Version={version} | PID={pid} | Mode={mode} | Reason={reason} | Exit-Code={code} | Duration={duration:.3f}s
log_tidy_optional: ; optional, not used by the current HTML checker (html5lib)
